Color Code Converter

Type a color in HEX, RGB or HSL format and instantly see it converted to all three formats with a preview swatch.

Accepts 3/6/8-digit hex, rgb()/rgba() and hsl()/hsla(). Alpha is preserved where possible.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste a color in HEX, RGB or HSL format.
  2. Click Convert.
  3. See the HEX, RGB and HSL readouts plus a live preview swatch.
  4. Click any readout to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which color formats are accepted?

Hex like #ff0000 (3, 6 or 8 digits), rgb(255, 0, 0), rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5), hsl(0, 100%, 50%) and hsla(0, 100%, 50%, 0.5).

How do I copy a converted value?

Click any of the HEX, RGB or HSL result rows to copy that exact value to your clipboard.

What happens with an invalid color?

You will see a clear error message explaining that the color could not be recognized.
